sources.name: NC-30 2026 Income Tax Withholding Tables and Instructions

notes: Read from the 2026 NC-30, annualized method (pages 17-20), on 2026-10-18: withholding rate 4.09% (3.99% income tax rate plus 0.1%), standard deduction $12,750 single/married and $19,125 head of household, $2,500 per allowance, result rounded to the nearest whole dollar.
Official worked example on page 20: $450 weekly, single, 2 allowances withholds $4.

Sign-off recorded 2026-10-18 on the owner's instruction, after the numbers were compared with the sources listed in this file. Editorial text in src/lib/states.ts and any limits listed above were not independently reviewed.
